_about: Single source of truth for the Figma↔CSS token mapping in the pOS Core design system. For every Figma variable, stores: the corresponding CSS custom property name, the full resolution chain (semantic → primitive), the resolved value in light, dark, and accessibility (high-contrast) mode, and the sync status. Fields: a11y_chain / a11y_resolved / a11y_direct_ref carry the accessibility (high-contrast) mode values (Figma BT Color Variables HC mode, added 2026-04-25; fields renamed from hc_* to a11y_* 2026-09-16). This is the authoritative reference for which Figma token maps to which CSS variable — used by the /token-sync command to compare live Figma values against the CSS, and by AI tools for component generation and token validation. Update manually after every token change (value, name, or reference chain). Do not derive the mapping from any other file.
